name: True colour, worldwide (VIIRS on NOAA-20, NASA GIBS, daily)
description: The Earth in daylight as the VIIRS imager on NOAA-20 saw it: true-colour corrected reflectance, one picture a day from its passes around 13:30 local time (about 50 minutes from Suomi NPP's), rendered by NASA GIBS. Cloud, smoke, dust, snow, floods and burn scars. Today's picture fills in as passes arrive; yesterday's is complete. Off by default: for before and after, use the Compare imagery command.
